messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to match the hairstyle shape shown in the reference images (front and back views). Transfer only the hairstyle shape from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's existing hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands facing the camera, then turns his head to the side, raises his right hand to his chest, and looks down before returning to face forward.","camera":"The camera holds a static medium close-up at eye level.","clothing":"He wears a white ribbed tank top with a dark graphic on the lower front.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"He has short black hair with a high, flat-top style and a distinct side part.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short facial hair is centered in the frame.","scene":"The background is a dark, futuristic interior with large glass windows, pink and blue neon lighting, and a glowing 'TRA' sign."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's blue hair was replaced with a short black hairstyle featuring a high flat-top shape and a side part, resembling the reference shape. The face, clothing, scene, lighting, and motion remain largely consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images' shape, while preserving the person's existing hair color and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the new hairstyle fully matches the reference shape from all angles, since the video does not clearly show the back of the head.
unexpected_changes: The hair color changed from blue to black, contrary to the instruction to preserve the existing hair color.
